title: Counting with a for Loop
description: Examine the three parts of a Java for loop header (initialization, condition, update) as it prints 0 through 9.

steps.description: Declare int i = 0 and read the block comment explaining the three semicolon-separated parts of a for loop header.
Write for(i = 0; i < 10; i++) on line 8 and System.out.println(i) inside the loop body on line 9.

steps.question: What value does i have when the loop condition i < 10 finally becomes false, and why is 9 the last number printed?
steps.answer: After printing 9, the update i++ increments i to 10; then i < 10 evaluates 10 < 10 (false), ending the loop before line 9 can run with i = 10.

steps.description: Check the final state at line 11 after the loop finishes: i holds 10 and the output ends at 9.
